styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Optical alignment, Zepto-style speed density in dashboard, expansive luxury pacing in marketing.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg rounded-none or very slight rounded-md font-bold tracking-wide transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-accent-foreground hover:bg-accent/90 shadow-md rounded-md font-bold transition-all

cards.dashboard_style: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 rounded-lg

components.inputs: bg-white border-border focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-accent rounded-md text-sm
components.dialogs: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95 border border-border/50 shadow-2xl rounded-xl

motion.staggered_list: use framer-motion for staggering children by 0.1s

iconography.style: stroke-[1.5] text-primary for main icons, text-muted-foreground for secondary, text-accent for highlights

landing_page.hero: Split layout or massive centered typography with Cabinet Grotesk. Hero image overlay max 30%. High contrast CTA.
landing_page.services_grid: Bento box 'Tetris' grid. Showcasing speed and trust.
landing_page.stats: Large typography displaying India-wide court coverage.

advocate_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + Topbar for wallet/profile. Main area uses 'Control Room' dense grid.
advocate_dashboard.quick_order: Zepto-style service grid (Photocopy, E-Filing, Notary) at the very top for sub-30s ordering.
advocate_dashboard.active_orders: Prominent tracker with real-time status (Blinkit style).

smart_order_wizard.flow: Multi-step modal or dedicated clean screen. Step 1: Upload (Drag & Drop), Step 2: Service/Options, Step 3: State/Court Select (Cascading dropdowns), Step 4: Review & Payment.
smart_order_wizard.ux: Progress bar at top. Clear INR pricing breakdown. Auto-calculating AI estimates.

tracking_page.layout: Two-column. Left: 12-step vertical timeline (e-Filing, Printing, Stamping, Delivery). Right: Map or Courier info.
tracking_page.components: Shadcn Progress, badges for status, Avatar for delivery partner.

marketplace_browse.layout: Filter sidebar (Left) + Grid of services/vendors (Right). IndiaMART style density but cleaner.
marketplace_browse.vendor_card: Shows rating, courts served, turnaround time, 'Verified' badge.

admin_dashboard.layout: Data-heavy. Cardless tables for vendor management, commission splits, and court mappings.

hero_marketing.description: Indian Courthouse building for scale and trust

legal_printing.description: Stack of legal papers representing document services

fast_delivery.description: Fast courier delivery on motorcycle representing quick turnaround

legal_trust.description: Legal gavel for authority and marketplace trust

specific_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
specific_rules.localization: Use ₹ (INR) for all currency. Use Indian legal terms like 'Cause List', 'Vakalatnama', 'Paper Book'.
specific_rules.trust_signals: KYC Verified badges on vendor profiles, GST compliant invoices, Court-verified stamps.
specific_rules.shadcn_overrides: Do not use default Shadcn border radius. Use subtle rounded-md for strict enterprise feel, or rounded-lg for softer modern feel. Override primary colors with the deep navy.
specific_rules.css_variables: Map all theme colors to index.css CSS variables for Tailwind configuration.
